limits: no L07 dispatcher lease or writer token; bounded repair applied by L01 under explicit L07-to-L01 preparation sublease
no exact pilot command signature, procedure binding, transaction owner or hook order proved
no authorized raw SQL/source/runtime opened or executed
no database mutation, lock test or legacy command dispatch
no product code, CI or current-head implementation test
no GitHub mutation or issue closure is proved by this local artifact
objective: Block purge, retry and dispatch until ledger retention windows and a coherent cross-store restore frontier are evidenced.

requirements.name: OutcomeUnknown/InProgress retention floor
requirements.acceptance: never silently purged or made reusable

requirements.name: safe tombstone schema
requirements.acceptance: stable key and immutable fingerprint survive payload purge

requirements.name: business store restore identity
requirements.acceptance: verified backup and restored frontier marker

requirements.name: ledger restore identity
requirements.acceptance: ledger frontier joins business commit identity

requirements.name: audit restore identity
requirements.acceptance: audit frontier joins operation and actor identity

requirements.name: outbox/hook restore identity
requirements.acceptance: mandatory effect frontier and replay rule

requirements.name: dispatch-disabled restore rehearsal
requirements.acceptance: isolated restore begins with dispatch disabled

requirements.name: wall-clock and skew source
requirements.acceptance: authoritative clock, skew and expiry semantics

requirements.name: independent review and exact-head evidence
requirements.acceptance: reviewed policy, isolated rehearsal and exact-head checks

state_machine.rule: only an independently reviewed evidence set may advance readiness; wall-clock age alone never enables purge, reuse, replay or dispatch

cases.expected: blocked until the verified terminal window and safe tombstone contract apply

cases.stimulus: purge an OutcomeUnknown/InProgress key after a guessed timeout
cases.expected: deny; unknown/in-progress keys are never silently purged into reusable slots

cases.stimulus: restore business data newer than the idempotency ledger
cases.expected: dispatch disabled until a compatible restore frontier and reconciliation are proved

cases.stimulus: restore ledger newer than business data
cases.expected: dispatch disabled; do not infer missing business effects are safe to replay

cases.stimulus: restore business and ledger while audit or outbox is older
cases.expected: block readiness because business/ledger/audit/outbox frontiers diverge

cases.stimulus: request old result after tenant, company or permission change
cases.expected: current authorization controls disclosure regardless of original completion

cases.stimulus: claim recovery from backup existence without isolated restore
cases.expected: remain blocked until isolated cross-store restore and reconciliation evidence exists

cases.stimulus: set a retention duration without legal/business/config provenance
cases.expected: reject invented duration and preserve UNKNOWN

cases.stimulus: wall-clock moves backward or nodes disagree around expiry
cases.expected: no automatic purge/reuse; authoritative clock and skew policy required

cases.stimulus: promote readiness from local fixtures or owner self-review
cases.expected: deny until independent review, exact-head checks and isolated rehearsal all pass
